summary: Mr. Waters taught me to stop-time. Pause, listen. New paths. 'Tonic pitches cast in progressions of lost time unfolding histories held in a cradle of tonality pointing to half steps in turnarounds of my life #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Mr. Waters
taught me to
stop-time.

Pause,
listen.
New paths.

'Tonic pitches
cast in progressions
of lost time
unfolding
histories
held in a
cradle of
    tonality
pointing to
  half steps
in turnarounds
of my life
#smallpoems
